mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 70% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 5% MoM AND UNRATE rises > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where both HOUST declines by more than 5% MoM and UNRATE rises by more than 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increases by more than 2% QoQ during a late-cycle expansion.
